notes: Verify method: downloaded and text-extracted every cited source — 2025 Fla. Stat. ss. 119.07, 119.011, 119.01, 215.322 (flsenate.gov), Fla. Admin. Code r. 1-2.0031 (flrules.org rule .doc, History New 3-21-06/Amended 9-17-08), and the 2024 Government-in-the-Sunshine Manual (Vol. 46) via the cited Town of Jupiter Island mirror — then machine-matched every source_language fragment (whitespace/quote-mark-insensitive). All 36 rows' quotes are present verbatim; apparent mismatches were page-header strings ('185/186/187 GOVERNMENT-IN-THE-SUNSHINE-MANUAL') interrupting quotes mid-sentence in the PDF text layer, plus '8 1/2' spacing. Currency re-verified: s. 119.07 History ends s. 1, ch. 2021-173 (no 2024-2026 amendment to subsection (4)); CS/HB 437 (2026) confirmed on the flsenate bill page as passed House 111-0 on 3/4/2026 and Died in [Senate] Rules 3/13/2026; a web search surfaced no 2026 act touching 119.07(4). Municipal scope re-verified: s. 119.011(2) 'agency' includes 'any state, county, district, authority, or municipal officer'; agency-only figures (DOS r. 1-2.0031's 15-minute/quarter-hour/prepayment scheme) are consistently recorded as agency-specific guidance with the municipal resolution 'silent' — none leaked into a municipal value. Resolution words check out: both statutory dollar figures ('up to 15 cents', 'up to $1') are recorded as ceilings, not values; every soft standard (actual cost of duplication, 'extensive', 'reasonable') carries no number (labor.overheadPct's 0 encodes the categorical overhead prohibition of s. 119.011(1)/AGO 99-41, not an invented figure).
